title: Neon Cycles round state diagram
description: Where a match stands. main.gd's _physics_process acts on the state: it simulates the riders in every state but PAUSED, and starts a new round from several of them.

states.description: 3, 2, 1, GO over the four riders at their spawns; they start moving at GO.
The riders move, turn and crash. After the player crashes, the camera follows a rider still racing.
One rider (or none) is left; the winner scores and the next round starts after three seconds.
A rider has won five rounds; the match waits for Enter.
The tree is paused; the state before it is kept.

transitions.trigger: one rider or none is left, and nobody has five wins
the last rider left reaches five wins
Enter after the player has crashed, or R

transitions.action: resets every score and starts round 1

transitions.trigger: Esc or P, when the game was playing
Esc or P, when the game was counting down
Esc or P, when the game was in ROUND_OVER
Esc or P, when the game was in MATCH_OVER
